name: PantryPal
one_liner: Snap a photo of your fridge to instantly get three recipes you can cook right away.
problem: People often struggle to decide what to cook with the ingredients currently sitting in their fridge.
audience: Home cooks and busy individuals looking to make meals from ingredients they already have.

features.name: Fridge Photo Ingredient Detection
features.description: Captures a photo of the fridge and detects available ingredients automatically.

features.name: Recipe Suggestions
features.description: Suggests three recipes ranked by how many detected ingredients they utilize.

features.name: Missing Ingredients Shopping List
features.description: Generates a shopping list for any missing items needed for the suggested recipes.

flow.text: The user opens PantryPal to the home screen.
The user taps the camera button to access the camera view.
The user takes a photo of their open fridge.
The app detects the visible ingredients from the captured image.
The user views three suggested recipes ranked by ingredient overlap.
The user checks the shopping list for the few missing ingredients.
